title: THE FLAW OF AVERAGES: QUANTIFYING UNIFORMITY OF PERFORMANCE ON BENCHMARKS
reasoning: The paper evaluates and analyzes model performance across the 57 subtasks of the MMLU benchmark as a core component of its experimental validation. This includes specific subtasks for 'World Religions', 'Moral Disputes', 'Moral Scenarios', 'Professional Ethics', and 'Philosophy', which are individually plotted and analyzed in the model-wise decomposition sections (Section D and Figure 10).
